title: Sky Elements drones fall from the sky over the East Field

tellings.quote: all of them start behaving mysteriously and start dropping like bricks from the sky.

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property long known for reports of strange happenings, says that sometime between 2023 and 2025 drones flown by Sky Elements, a drone company, were over the part of the ranch called the East Field, or the triangle, when all of them began behaving mysteriously and started "dropping like bricks from the sky." Fugal tells Michels this as something that happened on his own land, and he offers it as a sign that something in that spot interferes with machines.
